description:
READ-ONLY: generate a client handoff document (markdown) from the plan:
    site URL(s), admin email, installed apps, backup schedule + destination, how to
    request a report/support, and a recommended next review (+6 months). Returns
    `{markdown: "..."}`. Computes locally - no mutation.

    `secrets_path` names the file that actually holds this instance's passwords (an extra
    instance uses secrets_<slug>.json). `backup_verified` MUST be passed True ONLY if
    backup_verify actually ran + passed for this deploy - otherwise the doc honestly says the
    restore-drill still needs to be run, instead of claiming a test that never happened.
name: handoff_doc
